en.t: I can only blame my own shortsightedness.

units.source_text: 我虽然不喜欢用郁金香做和服和腰带的图案，但是出自名家的手，即使是郁金香图案，也会有长久的生命。”

en.t: Although I do not like using tulips as patterns for kimono and obi, in the hands of a master, even a tulip design can have lasting life.

units.source_text: 太吉郎的脸依然扭向一边，

en.t: Taikichiro's face was still turned to one side,

units.source_text: “就以古代书写断片来说也一样，

en.t: It is the same with fragments of ancient writing,

units.source_text: 再没有比这古都的更古老了。

en.t: there is nothing older than those from this old capital.

units.source_text: 这么美的东西，却没人愿意去画，只是临摹。”

en.t: Something so beautiful, yet no one is willing to paint it; they only copy it.
